annotations.title: File a Topic in a Room

description: Place one of this person's curiosities' topics in a room — either an existing room_id from list_rooms, or a new_room_name when nothing fits. This takes effect immediately; there is no human review step, so do not say it is awaiting confirmation. Note what it does NOT do: it files the TOPIC, it does not put the person in the room — they still have to join_room themselves. A topic can only be placed once; if it already has a room, that stands. Prefer an existing room_id: a second room for the same subject splits the people in it.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

curiosity_id.description: A confirmed curiosity id from get_profile_context.

new_room_name.description: A name for a room that should exist but does not.

room_id.description: An existing room id. Omit if suggesting a new room.
